title: If you enjoy torn up food, get this pan.
text: If you enjoy torn up food, get this pan.. I have used this pan for high fat meals including bacon and eggs, on a daily basis, so it is very well seasoned. At most, we rinse it off just to help get food debris out and then wipe it with some oil. At the next use, it will get butter, oil or lard to cook in, so there is no reason why this pan should be destroying our food through the horrendous amount of sticking that occurs. The surface of this pan is rough and it is difficult to use even a very thin spatula to get under whatever it is you are cooking. Even after a good sear, our pork, chicken and eggs are torn apart and this is not acceptable. We will be throwing this pan in the trash.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Kitchen - Saute Fry Pan - Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron Skillet With Lid - Nonstick Frying Pan 8 inch - Cast Iron Pan - Safe Grill Cookware for indoor & Outdoor Use
features: CAST IRON PAN – The Cast Iron Grill Pan comes with pre-seasoned quality, making it ready for use straight out of the box and preventing any rusting issue. Our cast iron pan set comes with unique handles for easy maneuvering and pouring.
EVEN HEAT DISTRIBUTION – Our premium quality non-toxic cookware set is coated with an extra layer of protection that ensures the equal distribution of heat for an improved cooking experience.

VERSATILE USAGE – The skillet pans are highly compatible, as they can be used on any heating source. You can also use them for grilling, frying, sautéing, roasting, braising, and broiling meats, vegetables, and more.

SEASONING GUIDE – Our skillets are pre-seasoned but it is recommended to season the cast iron pan set with any vegetable oil before use. After washing, rub some oil over your cookware's surface and place it in an oven at low temperature for the oil to seep in.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS – Cool the skillets completely before washing in hot soapy water with a sponge using a regular dishwashing liquid soap.
